# technitium_record_uri (Resource)

Manages a single `URI` record in an authoritative zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_zone" "uri_home" {
  zone = "uri.example.com"
}

resource "technitium_record_uri" "sip" {
  zone         = technitium_zone.uri_home.zone
  domain       = "_sip._tcp.uri.example.com"
  uri_priority = 10
  uri_weight   = 1
  uri          = "https://sip.uri.example.com/"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The record's domain name, for example `www.example.com`. Use the zone name for a record at the zone apex.
- `uri` (String) The target URI.
- `uri_priority` (Number) The target's priority. Lower values are tried first.
- `uri_weight` (Number) The relative weight of targets with the same priority.
- `zone` (String) The authoritative zone that holds the record.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Comments stored with the record.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable the record without deleting it. Defaults to `false`.
- `expiry_ttl` (Number) Deletes the record automatically this many seconds after it was last modified. Terraform then creates it again on the next apply. Defaults to `0`, which keeps the record.
- `ttl` (Number) The record TTL in seconds. Defaults to the default record TTL in the server settings.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# the URI contains "/", so use the JSON form of the identity attributes
terraform import technitium_record_uri.sip '{"zone":"uri.example.com","domain":"_sip._tcp.uri.example.com","uri_priority":10,"uri_weight":1,"uri":"https://sip.uri.example.com/"}'
```
